about: Report messages for the report reader extensions/next-prompt/report.ts (test/next-prompt.test.ts). It gives the class: report, ambiguous or missing. For a report, draft is the label of the next-prompt draft, or null for no draft. dialog is the text of an earlier assistant message that opened the question tool before the final message.
